name: Bottom Nav
description: A mobile bottom navigation bar of three to five icon-and-label items with aria-current and safe-area padding.
usage:
<BottomNav>
  <BottomNavItem active href="/home" icon={<Home />} label="Home" />
  <BottomNavItem href="/search" icon={<Search />} label="Search" />
  <BottomNavItem badge={3} href="/alerts" icon={<Bell />} label="Alerts" />
  <BottomNavItem href="/profile" icon={<User />} label="Profile" />
</BottomNav>

anatomy.description: Fixed bottom nav landmark with safe-area padding for notched devices.
Icon-and-label links sharing the width equally; the active one sets aria-current="page".
Optional count bubble on an item for unseen activity.

dos: Keep it to three to five top-level destinations.
Hide it at desktop widths and switch to a Sidebar or Top Bar.
donts: Don't use it for hierarchical or numerous destinations.
Don't put creation actions like compose here; it switches destinations.

examples.title: Four destinations
examples.description: The default mobile pattern with an active destination and a badge count on the alerts icon.

examples.title: Five destinations
examples.description: Items share the bar width equally up to the recommended maximum of five destinations.

guidance.useWhen: A mobile app has three to five top-level destinations the user switches between constantly.
guidance.avoidWhen: Destinations are numerous or hierarchical; use a Sidebar or Drawer pattern instead, and hide BottomNav on desktop widths.
guidance.behavior: Items are links with equal flex width; the active item exposes aria-current="page", and the bar pads for the device safe area with env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
guidance.responsive: Fixed to the bottom edge and full width; at desktop widths replace it with a Sidebar or TopBar navigation.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the destination links.

notes: Renders a navigation landmark with a configurable aria-label.
The active item is announced as the current page through aria-current="page".
Badge counts render as text next to the label, so they are announced rather than color-only.

props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Marks the item as the current page; sets `aria-current="page"`.
props.name: active

props.description: Small badge content shown on the corner of the icon, such as a count.
props.name: badge
